capabilities: Render skiss code blocks as class diagrams using Obsidian's Mermaid
Colour skiss blocks while writing and mark errors and warnings in the gutter
List open questions and comments from a block below the diagram
Export a note's blocks as LinkML, Mermaid, SVG or PNG to a file or the clipboard
Export a glossary or a terms table as Markdown from the note's blocks
extras: Discloses clipboard write-only behaviour, no network requests, and that exports write only beside the note; a BRAT path exists for pre-release builds.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to sketch a data model as a live diagram in a note and turn that sketch into a usable schema.
summary: Renders skiss code blocks, a text notation for data models, as class diagrams while typing, and exports them to LinkML, Mermaid, SVG, PNG and glossary files.
